scope: Independent adversarial code and design review, actual native identity/transport/capacity audit, owner-runner review, and final candidate/source bindings. Python return gate reviewed separately by its owner.

findings_resolved.resolution: T13 preserves app_id/ack_bits/dack_bits as uint64, forces CSV imports of exact columns to strings before reading, compares exact decimal strings, and tests actual >2^53 exported maps. Native data reaches uint64 maximum.

findings_resolved.resolution: Aligned before executed/final reference generation; exact input generation time and identity audit passed.

review_observations: Real NWK/HOP/MAC baseline code remains unchanged; synthetic finite generation consults production application-state NSDP16 before actual NWK Send. Callback wrappers access completed layer cells at invocation time.

Loss is determined once at actual aggregate TX start per addressed recipient, then cached until arrival. Dropped segments cause no MAC heard/reservation updates or HOP ingress, and no synthetic feedback is generated.
Generation callbacks are queued in input CSV order before admission polling; original due times persist independently of admission delays.
Whole emitted segment multiset equals TX observations and partitions exactly into pass-ingress-before/after versus loss observations with identity, sequence, and exact uint64 bitmaps.

Stable pending capacity equals resends plus DACK holds, and all custody equals NSDP4+NSDP5. Active queued data and blocked offers overlap DACK holds in source4, including after20s; data resumes as holds clear.
Receiver-side deliveries and sender/relay HOP terminals remain distinct. DACK normalization changes reporting semantics only; original native trace reason and false flag remain preserved.
Runner preserves fixed baseline hashes, exact test identity lists, before/after source/reference snapshots, honest diagnostic/acceptance flags, partial failure outputs, and short t13 paths.
limitations: No MATLAB runtime was available; all88 selected MATLAB tests await owner execution.

Fixed preconditioned routes, fixed nominal128kbps/+33dBm, prescribed successful or dropped transport; no RF/collision/half-duplex, discovery/reconvergence, adaptive radio, node reset, or campus claim.
Native ACK-loss case recovers through later cumulative feedback with zero DATA retransmissions. Native DATA and out cases each have two DATA retransmissions.
Actual blackout losses are two singleton DATA groups on5->1; the configured policy covers both links/directions but other direction losses are not observed in this particular blackout run.
Exact native/MATLAB trace parity is not yet assessed. Existing startup timing and intermediate callback-state differences remain permitted reported residuals.
